ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity macro ratio; approximately 80% white surface area against 20% low-intensity black patterning, concentrated at margins and the insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous high-intensity white blobs cover the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixel bands define the entire trailing edge. A centralized dark mottled cluster is located at the fluke-to-peduncle junction. Distinctive linear black strokes are mapped at [lower-left-interior] and [mid-right-interior] regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged 'saw-tooth' peaks concentrated on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve, while the trailing edges follow a broad concave sweep with significant local deviation due to serration density.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel rosettes (consistent with barnacle attachment) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel vertical low-intensity linear disruptions on the lower interior portion of the left lobe; additional scattered horizontal linear marks on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral scarring and calcification at the distal tips; distinct rake-like linear trauma on the ventral surface of the left lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric jagged notch located approximately 15% inward from the right fluke tip along the trailing edge boundary.
